label: SvelteKit 3
streaming: buffered (no streamed promises returned from load)
notes: kit.paths.origin is set to http://127.0.0.1:4404 at build time: adapter-node 6 reads the origin from it (the ORIGIN env var of adapter-node 5 is gone) and otherwise assumes https, which makes the CSRF check reject every plain-http form POST.

adapter-node: node:http (polka) → sirv static handler for build/client → SvelteKit server.respond. precompress is on by default for static assets (.gz/.br written at build, served only when the client sends Accept-Encoding); SSR HTML is never compressed.
formatPrice is restated in src/lib/price.ts because components cannot import $lib/server modules; byte-identical function.
data-sveltekit-preload-data="hover" kept from the scaffold (default link prefetch on hover).
